free_tier.stated: Free plan at EUR 0: 1 seat, 2 concurrents, USD 1 of usage credit per month for compute and storage, and 1 GB of pipeline cache; all features except SSO and advanced permissions
free_tier.notes: the USD 1 credit buys CPU-minutes, GB-minutes and GB-hours at the published rates, so the free allowance is a dollar budget rather than a fixed minute count; 1 GB of pipeline cache is included on top

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap stated; the free plan includes 1 GB of pipeline cache

retention.stated: a free workspace with no login is frozen after 60 days and permanently terminated if no action is taken in the following 30 days; pipeline runs alone do not count as activity
retention.notes: the 90 days is the sum of the 60-day inactivity window and the following 30 days before permanent termination: 60 + 30 = 90

egress.terms: no egress allowance or per-GB price is published; storage is billed per GB-hour at USD 0.00011 for sandbox and artifact storage and USD 0.00068 for the pipeline cache

interface_detail: the REST API is described by an OpenAPI 3 specification and is reached at api.buddy.works, api.eu.buddy.works or api.asia.buddy.works with an OAuth2 bearer token; pipelines are defined in the web editor, in YAML or imported from YAML, and the bdy CLI starts and follows pipeline runs
tooling: a browser-based visual pipeline builder, YAML pipeline definitions, the bdy CLI and a REST API with an OpenAPI 3 specification; pipelines run in containers or Linux, Windows and macOS VMs with x64 or ARM64 CPUs; self-hosted Buddy installations exist but are software the reader installs and runs and come after this hosted offer
chaining: a Git push, pull request, schedule or webhook starts a pipeline; containers make up over 90% of actions and consume the USD 1 monthly credit at USD 0.00024 per CPU-minute and GB-minute, with higher GB-minute multipliers for Windows and macOS; a free pipeline stops once the credit is used up and resumes when it renews
